name: catras-claude-code-collection
description: Catra's collection of Claude Code mods and plugins

plugins.name: agent-comic
plugins.description: A pixel comic above the prompt: Claude acts out what the agent is doing, from a home hub with keepsakes he collects; hybrid or token-free scenes

plugins.name: cache-keepalive
plugins.description: A calm countdown of the prompt cache in the prompt footer, and a minimal keep-alive message just before it expires

plugins.name: claudle
plugins.description: Programming mini-games in a side pane to play while Claude works: Spot the Bug, What Does It Print?, Two Truths and a Lie, Real or Hallucinated?, Code Review Court and Big-O Bingo, with adaptive difficulty and an Ask Claude tutor
